interface.shortDescription: Computer work, Codex context and Subchat observations.
interface.longDescription: Files, searches and terminal work, with selected Codex conversations, skills and compatible MCP tools. A separate Subchat MCP uses a dedicated headless Chrome login and HTTP reads; generation and remote mutations are not exposed in that Plugin server. Public alpha. ChatGPT requires HTTPS setup; macOS native Accessibility GUI requires a verified helper and OS permission. Compatible Peekaboo is an optional external provider. Hosting is not included.
